utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a pretty good turnout already. If you want, I can pass along the details to anyone else on the block.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Really? Are you sure it’s already that busy?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, that’s what I heard from a couple folks nearby. I can check for the latest count if you want.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I might miss a few updates, so keep me in the loop if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep you in the loop and let everyone know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Ira — appreciate it. I’ll let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m curious how the repair drive is going—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re in good shape, but I still need a few basics sorted—mostly tools, tape, and a couple spare parts. If you can help check the list, that’d make things go a lot faster.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that—send me the list, and I’ll check what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time window are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Faye — maybe a Saturday morning window, like 9 to 11, so folks can stop by before plans start. If that works with the school schedule, we can keep it pretty easy for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning works for me — I’ll check the school calendar and help keep that 9 to 11 window clear.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep this simple—what’s the plan for the repair drive, and when do you need me there?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, I’m glad to keep it straightforward. Just tell me the time and place, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive is this Saturday afternoon—if you want, I can put your name down and swing by with some flyers.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday afternoon should work, but I’d want to be sure about the timing and where to bring the flyers. If you can jot my name down, I can help once I know the details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll jot your name down, and I’ll send you the exact time and drop-off spot as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is getting organized, but I’m still catching up on the details. If you know what they need most, I’d love to hear it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — we’re still pulling it together, but the biggest needs are volunteers, basic tools, and a few folks willing to help sort donations. If you’d like, I can send you the current list and where to plug in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks — I’d love the current list and a spot where I can help out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the details of the repair drive first? I want to make sure I get everything right before I act.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I’ll share the full details first, then you can act with confidence.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — I’m ready for the details whenever you are.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep it simple today.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli — even a little help goes a long way. I’ll keep it simple and let you know what’s most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. Just tell me the most urgent bit, and I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand or a tool if it helps with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s over by the community center lot, I think—just follow the signs.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I’ll head over there and look for the signs. If you need anything else, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m heading to the repair drive now—do you know exactly where it’s set up?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m just trying to find the exact spot for it—where is the repair drive set up?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring over a few tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’m still sorting the list, but a hammer and a wrench would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem — I’ve got both and can drop them off when you’re ready. Just give me a shout.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the exact time, pickup point, and what we’re bringing so I can plan it properly.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes, that makes sense—let’s get the exact time, pickup point, and list of supplies first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks—once we have those details, I can confirm whether I can make it and help coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I can help connect folks and spread the word about the repair drive. What do you want me to pass along?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Please tell folks the repair drive is this Saturday at the community hall, and we’re looking for small appliance, bike, and clothing repairs. If they can lend a hand or bring something by, that would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word that it’s this Saturday at the community hall, and that small appliance, bike, and clothing repairs are welcome. I’ll also mention that extra hands would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking our supplies now—what kind of repair items do you need for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m running a bit late, but I can bring duct tape, a hammer, and a few screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, I’ll note duct tape, a hammer, and screwdrivers. If you can, bring any spare nails or a tape measure too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are still collecting donations and lining up volunteers—sounds like it’s coming together nicely.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, that’s right — I’m trying to make sure the school schedule doesn’t get tangled up with it. If you hear of anyone who can help, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll keep an ear out and send anyone handy your way. Hopefully we can keep the school schedule nice and tidy too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Could you help by making a quick list of neighbors who need repairs and a few folks who can volunteer? I’ll coordinate the rest from there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’ll jot down a quick list of neighbors who need repairs and a few volunteers. I’ll send it over soon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — can you help sort the donations and label the boxes?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donations and label the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive now—want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks—yes, please save me a spot. I’m still hearing about it second-hand, so I’d appreciate the heads-up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll save you a spot and keep you posted as soon as I hear the details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have any repair drive details yet, but I can keep track once you share the location.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Opal. Let me know when you have the location, and I’ll keep to a clear plan from there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep an eye out for the location and let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the repair drive already get a date and place, or are we still figuring it out?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet — I should check the details before I say for sure. Let me look into the date and place.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — can you let me know once you check? I just want to make sure I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any fresh updates yet, but I’m happy to check in while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I’d really appreciate that. If you hear anything about the repair drive, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll ask around while I’m out and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.
